name: Build the administrative area hierarchy
title: Build the administrative area hierarchy
description:
Create the human-facing jurisdiction hierarchy against the correct Geo Dataset. Use stable source codes, a consistent level convention, explicit parent links, and honest source provenance (Imported, Verified, Manual, or Disputed). A parent must be saved before its child. Use `Is Group` only for nodes intended to contain children.

Do not mix country datasets or invent codes that resemble source identifiers. Preserve disputed/uncertain jurisdiction labels transparently and retain source notes. Check the parent chain and level in the saved record; the map lookup should resolve the intended area rather than a similarly named neighbor.
